summary: AstraZeneca files a Form 6-K reporting EU approval of Enhertu as a tumour-agnostic HER2-directed therapy for previously treated HER2-positive metastatic solid tumours. The filing is a routine regulatory announcement of a drug approval by the European Commission, based on Phase II trial data showing objective response rates across multiple tumour types. It contains no merger, acquisition, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation event. This is a standard disclosure of a regulatory milestone for an existing product partnership with Daiichi Sankyo.
